facts.value: within 7 working days or by the end of the next regular pay period, whichever is sooner
facts.summary: Arizona: when an employee is fired or laid off, final wages are due within 7 working days or by the end of the next regular pay period, whichever is sooner.
facts.evidence_quote: A. When an employee is discharged from the service of an employer, he shall be paid wages due him within seven working days or the end of the next regular pay period, whichever is sooner.

facts.value: no later than the regular payday for the pay period in which termination occurred
facts.summary: Arizona: when an employee is quits or resigns, final wages are due no later than the regular payday for the pay period in which termination occurred.
facts.evidence_quote: B. When an employee quits the service of an employer he shall be paid in the usual manner all wages due him no later than the regular payday for the pay period during which the termination occurred

facts.applies_to: As listed by U.S. DOL, page updated November 5, 2026
facts.summary: Arizona basic state minimum wage listed by U.S. DOL: $15.15.
facts.source_title: State Minimum Wage Laws (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: Local (city or county) minimum wages are not included. Scheduled January 1, 2027 increases are not reflected until DOL updates the page.

facts.value: Within 20 days of hire date A.R.S. 23-722.01(D)

facts.summary: Arizona: frequencies marked in the U.S. DOL State Payday Requirements table: Semi-monthly (note 3).
facts.source_title: State Payday Requirements (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: Note 3: Arizona. Payday two or more days in a month, not more than 16 days apart. | DOL table last revised 2023-01-01; DOL says to consult the state labor office for official information. Confirm against current state law before relying on it.

facts.summary: Arizona is not listed with a final 2026 FUTA credit reduction, so the effective FUTA rate is 0.6% on the first $7,000 per employee (if the full 5.4% state credit applies).
facts.evidence_quote: State not listed in the Final 2026 FUTA Credit Reductions table.
facts.source_title: Final 2026 Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Credit Reductions (updated November 10, 2026)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration
